select timestamp as time,
			submers_pump_1_remavail__value as submers_pump1_remavail,
			submers_pump_1_running__value as submers_pump1_running,
			submers_pump_2_remavail__value as submers_pump2_remavail,
			submers_pump_2_running__value as submers_pump2_running,
			submers_pump_3_remavail__value as submers_pump3_remavail,
			submers_pump_3_running__value as submers_pump3_running,
			bckup_gen_serv_pump_remavail__value as bckup_gen_serv_pump_remavail,
			gen_serv_pump_1_remavail__value as gen_serv_pump1_remavail,
			gen_serv_pump_2_remavail__value as gen_serv_pump2_remavail,
			gen_serv_pump_2_field_start__value as gen_serv_pump2_field_start,
			gen_serv_pump_2_field_stop__value as gen_serv_pump2_field_stop,
			strip_pump_remavail__value as strip_pump_remavail,
			strip_pump_running__value as strip_pump_running,
			chain_lock_pump_remavail__value as chain_lock_pump_remavail,
			chain_lock_pump_running__value as chain_lock_pump_running
from marpower__210000_bilge_fifi_general
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 1;

select max(ts) as ts,
			max(case
							when mqtt_json_path = lower('SUBMERS_PUMP1_REMAVAIL') then '(' || yard_tag || ')'
							else null
					end) as submers_pump1_remavail_tag,
			max(case
							when mqtt_json_path = lower('SUBMERS_PUMP1_RUNNING') then '(' || yard_tag || ')'
							else null
					end) as submers_pump1_running_tag,
			max(case
							when mqtt_json_path = lower('SUBMERS_PUMP2_REMAVAIL') then '(' || yard_tag || ')'
							else null
					end) as submers_pump2_remavail_tag,
			max(case
							when mqtt_json_path = lower('SUBMERS_PUMP2_RUNNING') then '(' || yard_tag || ')'
							else null
					end) as submers_pump2_running_tag,
			max(case
							when mqtt_json_path = lower('SUBMERS_PUMP3_REMAVAIL') then '(' || yard_tag || ')'
							else null
					end) as submers_pump3_remavail_tag,
			max(case
							when mqtt_json_path = lower('SUBMERS_PUMP3_RUNNING') then '(' || yard_tag || ')'
							else null
					end) as submers_pump3_running_tag,
			max(case
							when mqtt_json_path = lower('BCKUP_GEN_SERV_PUMP_REMAVAIL') then '(' || yard_tag || ')'
							else null
					end) as bckup_gen_serv_pump_remavail_tag,
			max(case
							when mqtt_json_path = lower('GEN_SERV_PUMP1_REMAVAIL') then '(' || yard_tag || ')'
							else null
					end) as gen_serv_pump1_remavail_tag,
			max(case
							when mqtt_json_path = lower('GEN_SERV_PUMP2_REMAVAIL') then '(' || yard_tag || ')'
							else null
					end) as gen_serv_pump2_remavail_tag,
			max(case
							when mqtt_json_path = lower('GEN_SERV_PUMP2_FIELD_START') then '(' || yard_tag || ')'
							else null
					end) as gen_serv_pump2_field_start_tag,
			max(case
							when mqtt_json_path = lower('GEN_SERV_PUMP2_FIELD_STOP') then '(' || yard_tag || ')'
							else null
					end) as gen_serv_pump2_field_stop_tag,
			max(case
							when mqtt_json_path = lower('STRIP_PUMP_REMAVAIL') then '(' || yard_tag || ')'
							else null
					end) as strip_pump_remavail_tag,
			max(case
							when mqtt_json_path = lower('STRIP_PUMP_RUNNING') then '(' || yard_tag || ')'
							else null
					end) as strip_pump_running_tag,
			max(case
							when mqtt_json_path = lower('CHAIN_LOCK_PUMP_REMAVAIL') then '(' || yard_tag || ')'
							else null
					end) as chain_lock_pump_remavail_tag,
			max(case
							when mqtt_json_path = lower('CHAIN_LOCK_PUMP_RUNNING') then '(' || yard_tag || ')'
							else null
					end) as chain_lock_pump_running_tag
from marpower__io_metadata
where mqtt_topic = 'marpower/210000-bilge-fifi-general'
ORDER BY ts DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT ON (topic)
  topic,
  alarm__value                  AS alarm,
  close__value                  AS close,
  closed__value                 AS closed,
  hmi_cmd_close__value          AS hmi_cmd_close,
  hmi_cmd_open__value           AS hmi_cmd_open,
  hmi_control_available__value  AS hmi_control_available,
  open__value                   AS open,
  opened__value                 AS opened,
  should_be_open__value         AS should_be_open
FROM marpower__210000_bilge_fifi
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY 
  topic, 
  timestamp DESC;
